svg.title: Raman excitation cleanup and return rejection — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A native 488 nm bandpass cleans the pump before a Raman specimen. The return collection branch includes a long-pass filter that rejects excitation before the photodetector. Raman channel yield and angular emission are simplified specimen inputs. Real filter optical density, molecular Raman tensors, linewidths and calibrated signal strength are not inferred.
